prompt: Write unittest source only no semicolons. Import random,unittest,Bio.Seq.Seq,Bio.SeqRecord.SeqRecord,alignment_candidates.alignment_candidates. Fixture random.Random(123) reference=''.join(rng.choice('ACGT') for _ in range(120)); entry fields sequence,feature_id='fixture',canonical_name='Synthetic',feature_type='misc_feature',source='synthetic',version='1'. Test partial: sequence reference[20:110], linear record; call candidates(record,[entry],[]); assert any h has match partial,identity1,coverage.75,location.strand1, set(h.location)==set(range(90)); assert none confidence High confidence. Test insertion reverse: target reference[:60]+'AAA'+reference[60:], reverse complement; candidates contains strand-1,coverage1, identity120/123, extracted feature seq equals target. Test circular: target reference[40:]+'NNNN'+reference[:40], topology circular; candidates contains forward location parts length2, identity1,coverage1, extracted seq reference. Test fast suppression: exact reference record; fast_hit entry same and location SimpleLocation(0,120,strand=1); candidates must not include forward matching same locus. Do not expect zero reverse incidental weak hits. Use SeqFeature(h['location']).extract(record.seq) for extraction. Main guard.
